data.body: Investigation (2026-05-12): Code analysis of acli-integration.py:554 shows 'epic'.capitalize() → 'Epic', which is a valid Jira Cloud issue type. No code bug found for epic creation path. Likely environment-specific: Jira project may not have 'Epic' issue type configured, or ACLI is not executing due to missing credentials. Bridge outbound status: BRIDGE_ALERT would be written if create_issue returns no key (line 190). Check BRIDGE_ALERT events for epic tickets for error details. Needs Jira admin verification of project issue type configuration.
